description: Returns the canonical public URL for a Neblla app in the gallery. The URL is not derived from the app id alone, because slugs and custom domains change it. `url` is the link users open, at <slug or id>.neblla.app (or the app's own domain). A new app is published there at once, and each publish of its draft (neblla_promote "publish") reaches it, unless the developer chose pre (`target`: "pro", the default, or "pre"). `promoted` says whether pro has a version; `draft` how many changes wait unpublished. `pre` is the private link of the app's pre, for the developer only: where publishes go while they test with target "pre". The slug can be renamed with neblla_set_slug. This is the Neblla-hosted address; an app the developer hosts on their own domain keeps its own URL.
name: neblla_get_app_url
title: Get app url
